basis: OMI average residential quotation (EUR/m2): mean of the mid-points of the minimum/maximum sale ranges of the residential typologies quoted in the comune's OMI zones; an official valuation quotation, not a transaction price
name: Afragola
notes: Afragola: Agenzia delle Entrate OMI consultation service, residential quotations per OMI zone, second semester of each year and the latest first semester (2015-10 to 2026-04), stamped 1 April / 1 October; the build interpolates between points. Zone value: mean of the mid-points of the sale ranges of the residential typologies (Abitazioni *, Ville e villini). City line: equal-weight chain-linked composite of the urban zones (rural 'Extraurbana' zones not fetched; steps beyond 50% discarded as zone redefinitions), anchored to the latest semester's mean. 9 zones with at least two points. Quotations are valuation ranges, not transaction prices; zones were redrawn in 2014 and 2024. Comparison: the rest of the province of Naples (all its comuni but the capital, this one included), annual, from the Statistiche regionali.
